_comment: What an enrolled device may reach, by name. Each is a fixed cluster address,
set as `clusterIP` on the Service it names - held together by
tests/go/repo/tunnel_routes_test.go, because a route to an address nothing
answers on converges cleanly and reaches nothing.
Read by both OpenTofu roots, so the list is written once: each site routes
these through its own tunnel (management/cluster/tunnel.tf), and the estate
puts them in the account-wide split tunnel (management/estate/), which is one
list for the whole Cloudflare account.
Addresses come from the bottom of the service range, which Kubernetes reserves
